app/db/core.py.summary: Added W-PERF additive/nullable columns to chapter_segments (performance_data, speaker_confidence, speaker_basis, speaker_evidence, needs_review, review_reasons, locked, ai_suggested) and characters (display_name, role, character_type, aliases, source_presence, source_profile, voice_guidance, needs_review, review_reasons, locked, ai_suggested), both in CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and add_column_if_missing migration paths. Nothing reads these columns yet -- no behavior change.

app/domain/chapters/performance_schema.p.summary: New module: Pydantic models for the canonical performance_data JSON format (SegmentKind, RenderingMode, RenderingValue, PerformanceAnnotation, ReviewAnnotation, PerformanceData, etc.) plus validate_performance_data(raw: dict) -> PerformanceData, raising PerformanceDataValidationError on malformed input. Mirrors design-docs/plans/proposals/performance_script_model/01-canonical-json-format.md.

app/domain/chapters/rendering.py.summary: New module: resolve_rendering(segment, mode, defaults) -> RenderingDecision, the single translation layer resolving one of 8 RenderingValues for a segment across 5 RenderingModes, per doc-01's precedence chain (studio_override > explicit_source_fact > ai_inference > character/scene/chapter/book/engine default). Built-in 60-cell kind x mode default matrix as final fallback. Depends on app/domain/chapters/performance_schema.py's types.

app/tts_server/plugin_loader.py.summary: _validate_manifest() now validates optional behavior.export_format (enum) and behavior.supports_per_span_voice/supports_emotion_style/supports_prosody/supports_break (booleans) when present; absent is fine. No manifest version bump. No real plugin manifest changed.

app/engines/behavior.py.summary: Added export_capabilities_for(engine_id, behavior=None) helper, mirroring behavior_for_engine's pattern, resolving the new export-layer capability fields (export_format, supports_per_span_voice, supports_emotion_style, supports_prosody, supports_break) with safe defaults (None/False) when absent. Consumed by the future export layer, not the render pipeline's has_behavior gate.

frontend/src/types/performanceScript.ts.summary: New TypeScript types mirroring app/domain/chapters/performance_schema.py field-for-field (SegmentKind, RenderingMode, RenderingValue, PerformanceAnnotation, ReviewAnnotation, PerformanceData, etc.).
